scope: Staff API and gateway boundary tests against the real apps and local Supabase Auth
environment: Native Windows pytest, isolated local Supabase; paid AI off
covers: missing, empty, wrong-scheme, garbage and forged bearer tokens are refused before business code with no tenant text in the body
CORS: exact local origins only; foreign, lookalike, null, other-port and https origins get no grant on preflight or simple requests; no credentials header; DELETE and unlisted headers refused
no-store, nosniff, no-referrer and X-Frame-Options DENY on every response of both the staff API and the gateway, including 404 and 401
declared Content-Length above 11 MiB or non-numeric rejected with 413
gateway exposes no staff route, docs, redoc or schema; signed routes exist and refuse unsigned bodies
per-user mutation limit: 30 admitted, 31st is 429 with Retry-After 60
mutation_checks: Replacing the CORS allowlist with '*' failed the CORS test; changing Cache-Control to public failed 3 tests; both files were restored (git diff empty) and the suite re-run green.
limits: expired, wrong-issuer and wrong-audience tokens were not exercised (they need Supabase-signed tokens)
rate limiting is a fixed per-minute window: boundary bursts and multi-process/clock behavior are not tested
browser-side CORS enforcement was not run; this checks the server's headers
no TLS, proxy identity or public-ingress claim
